**Memory commands** (@mem)
- `@mem status` — engine, counts, this session
- `@mem recall <words>` — search memory
- `@mem sessions <words>` — find past sessions by what you typed (no words = recent)
- `@mem load <n|id> [chat|summary|full|compact|lineage]` — paste a past session (lineage = it plus all its ancestors, oldest first) into your next message
- `@mem remember <text>` — keep a fact · `@mem rule <text>` — a rule · `@mem prefer <text>` — a preference · `@mem procedure How to <goal>: 1. … 2. …` — a way to do a thing
- `@mem forget <id>` · `@mem history <id>` — who changed a memory, when and why
- `@mem confirm <id>` — a memory is right: it counts as your word · `@mem correct <id> <text>` — what is true now replaces it
- `@mem curate` — tidy this project's memory now (merge what says the same, key values, check memories whose files changed, judge what sessions found may be wrong, write the dossier); `@mem undo <r>` puts a pass back
- `@mem inbox` — memory's questions for you; `@mem accept <q>` · `@mem reject <q>`
- `@mem off` / `@mem on` — memory for this chat
- `@mem new` — start a fresh memory session here (in a chat of the harness's own: New chat)
